LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public casino player progression entry on the global XP leaderboard (strictly excludes PII).

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public casino player moniker shown on the global Top 100 leaderboard (1-30 chars).

totalXp.description: Total cumulative XP earned across casino sessions (>= 0).

vipTitle.description: Display title of the player's current VIP tier.

totalRoundsPlayed.description: Total rounds played across Poker, Slots, Blackjack, Roulette, and Baccarat (>= 0).

royalePoints.description: Spendable Royale Points loyalty balance earned from gameplay volume (>= 0).

lifetimeRoyalePoints.description: Cumulative lifetime Royale Points determining the player's loyalty tier (>= 0).

loyaltyTier.description: Display title of the player's Royale Loyalty Tier (1-40 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DailyLoginRecord.title: DailyLoginRecord
DailyLoginRecord.description: Owner-isolated daily login bonus state storing last login and claim server timestamps for streak tracking.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

currentStreak.description: Current consecutive daily login bonus streak (>= 0).

bestStreak.description: Highest consecutive daily login bonus streak achieved (>= 0).

lastClaimedChips.description: Virtual chips/credits awarded on the most recent daily login bonus claim (>= 0).

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent login session (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

lastBonusClaimAt.description: Optional server timestamp of the most recent daily bonus claim used to track consecutive day eligibility (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

lastWheelSpinAt.description: Optional server timestamp of the most recent 24-hour Daily Bonus wheel spin claim (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily login record was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily login record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global leaderboard ordered by totalXp descending; readable by signed-in players, writable only by the matching userId owner.

/dailyLogins/{userId}.description: Per-user daily login bonus streak and server login timestamp record; readable and writable only by the matching userId owner.
